children: ADOBE INC. reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue of $6.76B and diluted EPS of $4.62, driven by subscription growth and strength across Creative and Experience products.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted net income per share”.
Subscription revenue rose 14% year-over-year to $6.58B, supporting total revenue growth of 13% to $6.76B.
Adobe consolidated prior reporting segments into a single reportable segment to support unified selling and integrated product development.
Strength in Creative Cloud, Acrobat, Adobe Experience Manager, GenStudio and Firefly contributed to ARR growth to $27.5B, up 11.2% year-over-year.
Investment increased in R&D and hosting to support AI training and inferencing, agentic web apps, and integrations such as Semrush.
Company emphasized ARR expansion, customer acquisition and retention, and ratable subscription delivery across Creative/Marketing and Business/Consumer groups.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
